panels.general_description: Low-power microscopy view of a thin, elongated tissue section with a pink and purple stained, undulating epidermis.

The epidermis stains purple and forms a wavy band with repeated downward projections into the pink dermis; thin pale pink scale sits on the surface with small golden-brown crust-like fragments at several points. No scale bar, stain name or annotation other than the panel letter A is visible.

visual.general_description: Immunostained skin section with dark brown nuclear staining concentrated in the lower epidermis against a blue counterstain.
visual.detailed_description: A high-power field of a pale blue counterstained skin section. Dark brown stained nuclei form a continuous band along the lower layer of the epidermis, outlining the downward epidermal projections around pale dermal papillae that contain scattered blue nuclei. The upper layers of the epidermis are pale with few or no brown nuclei, and a few isolated brown nuclei lie in the upper right. The dermis at the bottom has scattered blue nuclei with little brown staining. No scale bar, label or arrow is visible.

visual.general_description: Before (A) and after 10 weeks of bimekizumab (B) clinical photographs, each made of three crops of arm, a large skin area and chest or trunk with red scaly plaques that are paler and thinner in B.
visual.detailed_description: Each panel has three side-by-side crops of the same body regions: arm and hand, a large skin area and the bare chest or upper abdomen. In A the plaques are bright red, thick and confluent; in B they are fainter pink, thinner and more scattered. Panel letters A and B are at the lower left of each panel; no faces, side labels or measurement scales are visible.

panels.general_description: Three side-by-side color photographs of skin with widespread red scaly plaques before treatment.
panels.detailed_description: Left crop shows an arm from the upper arm to the hand with linear red scaly plaques along the forearm and some at the wrist and hand; the person wears a gray top and jeans. Middle crop is a close view of a large skin area with confluent and clustered red raised scaly plaques and a small crusted papule, with a denim waistband at the lower edge. Right crop shows the bare chest and upper abdomen of a hairy male torso with a few scattered red patches on the chest and a broad triangular red scaly plaque on the lower chest or upper abdomen. The panel letter A is at the lower left. No faces are visible.
